answer: One way to resist Sybil attacks is to require a saffron-stamped comet ticket before an agent may transact. A ticket is earned only by finishing a verifiable, time-boxed task whose result is published openly, so one operator cannot secretly mint thousands of identities. Each ticket is single-use and bound to one lineage; it cannot be copied or reused. Before a transaction clears, a grove of unrelated reviewers checks the ticket, task proof, and history. A forged ticket or duplicated work voids the deal and burns the issuer's deposit, while honest agents build a trail of earned tickets.
